The name Bevon carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bevon usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
